tranches.name: Tranche 1: Mainnet Infrastructure & Multi-Sig Treasury
tranches.phaseObjective: Deploy production-grade smart contracts to Base Mainnet with multi-signature treasury governance and complete open-source documentation to meet Base Builder Grants' deployed contract verification requirement.

deliverables.title: Base Mainnet Smart Contract Deployment with Verified Contract Address
deliverables.description: Migrate audited ERC-20 tokenomics and core protocol contracts from Base testnet to Base Mainnet. Deploy multi-signature treasury contract (3-of-5 Gnosis Safe) for decentralized governance. Complete Etherscan contract verification for all deployed contracts.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Verified contract addresses on Base Mainnet Etherscan (basescan.org) with source code published; Multi-sig treasury contract address with 3-of-5 signer configuration visible on-chain; Deployment transaction hashes and block numbers documented in public GitHub repository.

deliverables.title: Open-Source Codebase Publication with Comprehensive Documentation
deliverables.description: Publish complete protocol codebase to public GitHub repository under MIT or Apache 2.0 license. Create README with architecture overview, deployment instructions, and integration guides. Document all smart contract functions with NatSpec comments and generate automated documentation site.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Public GitHub repository URL with open-source license file; README.md with setup instructions, architecture diagrams, and API documentation; Auto-generated documentation site (e.g., using Docusaurus or GitBook) accessible via public URL; Minimum 80% code comment coverage verified via automated tooling.

deliverables.title: Automated Test Suite with 90%+ Coverage
deliverables.description: Build comprehensive Hardhat/Foundry test suite covering unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases for all mainnet contracts. Implement continuous integration pipeline with automated test execution on every commit. Achieve minimum 90% code coverage across all smart contracts.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: GitHub Actions or CircleCI workflow file showing automated test execution; Code coverage report published to Codecov or Coveralls showing 90%+ coverage; Test execution logs demonstrating all tests passing; Coverage badge displayed in repository README.

deliverables.title: Mainnet User Onboarding Interface (First 1,000 Users)
deliverables.description: Launch production web app with frictionless wallet connection (WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, MetaMask) on Base Mainnet. Implement gasless transactions via ERC-4337 account abstraction or gas sponsorship for first-time users. Onboard first 1,000 mainnet users with documented wallet addresses.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Live production URL with Web3 wallet integration connected to Base Mainnet; On-chain transaction data showing 1,000+ unique wallet addresses interacting with deployed contracts (queryable via Dune Analytics dashboard or custom subgraph); Screenshot documentation of gasless transaction implementation; Public analytics dashboard showing daily active users.

tranches.name: Tranche 2: Cross-Chain Settlement Pilot & Novel Utility Features
tranches.phaseObjective: Implement cross-chain settlement infrastructure with novel utility features that advance on-chain adoption, demonstrating clear innovation in interoperability and user experience for Base ecosystem.

deliverables.title: Cross-Chain Bridge Integration with Settlement Pilot
deliverables.description: Integrate cross-chain messaging protocol (LayerZero, Chainlink CCIP, or Axelar) to enable asset settlement between Base and at least 2 other EVM chains (Ethereum L1, Optimism, Arbitrum, or Polygon). Deploy and verify bridge contracts on all target chains. Execute minimum 50 cross-chain settlement transactions as pilot validation.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Verified bridge contract addresses on Base Mainnet and minimum 2 additional EVM chains with Etherscan verification; On-chain transaction records showing 50+ successful cross-chain message/asset transfers with source and destination transaction hashes; Public-facing bridge interface URL; Technical documentation in GitHub explaining bridge architecture and security model.

deliverables.title: Novel Utility Feature: Intent-Based Transaction Batching
deliverables.description: Implement intent-based transaction system allowing users to express desired outcomes without managing complex multi-step transactions. Build smart contract infrastructure for atomic batch execution with automatic slippage protection and MEV resistance. Enable one-click complex operations (e.g., 'swap and stake', 'bridge and provide liquidity').
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Deployed intent resolver smart contract on Base Mainnet with verified source code; GitHub documentation explaining intent specification format and resolver logic; Minimum 100 successfully executed intent-based transactions recorded on-chain; Video demonstration showing user executing complex multi-step operation with single signature; Performance metrics dashboard showing average gas savings vs. manual execution.

deliverables.title: User Growth to 5,000 Mainnet Wallets
deliverables.description: Scale mainnet user base from 1,000 to 5,000 active wallet addresses through targeted onboarding campaigns, community partnerships, and referral mechanisms. Implement on-chain referral rewards system to incentivize organic growth. Track and report user retention and engagement metrics.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Dune Analytics dashboard or custom subgraph showing 5,000+ unique wallet addresses with minimum 2 transactions each; On-chain referral contract data showing reward distribution to community ambassadors; Weekly active user (WAU) and monthly active user (MAU) metrics exported from analytics platform; Transaction volume chart showing sustained growth trajectory.

deliverables.title: Security Audit Report for Mainnet Contracts
deliverables.description: Engage reputable third-party security firm (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, Consensys Diligence, or equivalent) to conduct comprehensive smart contract audit covering mainnet contracts and cross-chain bridge infrastructure. Remediate all critical and high-severity findings.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Published security audit report from recognized firm with firm's signature and date; GitHub commit history showing remediation of identified vulnerabilities; Final audit confirmation letter or attestation stating all critical/high issues resolved; Audit report shared on protocol website and documentation.

tranches.name: Tranche 3: Scaling to 10K Users & Ecosystem Integration
tranches.phaseObjective: Scale protocol to 10,000+ active users, integrate deeply with Base ecosystem infrastructure, and establish sustainable on-chain growth mechanisms that demonstrate long-term viability and adoption.

deliverables.title: Achievement of 10,000 Active Mainnet Users
deliverables.description: Reach and exceed 10,000 unique active wallet addresses on Base Mainnet through product-market fit optimization, partnership integrations, and community-driven growth. Ensure sustainable engagement with minimum 30% monthly active user rate. Document user journey analytics and retention cohorts.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Public Dune Analytics dashboard displaying 10,000+ unique addresses with transaction activity on Base Mainnet; Monthly active user (MAU) rate of 30%+ documented in analytics export; Cohort retention analysis showing Week 4 retention rates; On-chain transaction volume exceeding 50,000 total transactions; Third-party verification tweet from Base ecosystem account or grant program acknowledging milestone.

deliverables.title: Base Ecosystem Integration: Coinbase Wallet & Base Name Service
deliverables.description: Achieve native integration with Coinbase Wallet featured dApp directory. Implement Base Name Service (Basename) support for human-readable addresses throughout user interface. Partner with minimum 3 established Base ecosystem protocols for composable integrations (lending protocols, DEXs, NFT platforms).
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Screenshot or URL showing DecentralHer Labs featured in Coinbase Wallet dApp browser; Code commits demonstrating Basename resolution in frontend and smart contracts; Partnership announcement posts or co-marketing materials with 3 Base ecosystem protocols; On-chain transaction data showing composable contract calls between DecentralHer contracts and partner protocols.

deliverables.title: On-Chain Growth Mechanism: Self-Sustaining User Incentive Engine
deliverables.description: Deploy on-chain incentive contract with automated reward distribution based on measurable user actions (transactions, referrals, liquidity provision, governance participation). Implement treasury sustainability model with fee capture mechanism ensuring long-term protocol viability without continuous external funding.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Verified incentive distribution contract on Base Mainnet with transparent reward calculation logic; On-chain treasury dashboard showing fee revenue, reward distributions, and runway projection; Smart contract events log showing automated reward distributions to minimum 500 users; Financial model spreadsheet published in GitHub demonstrating 12-month sustainability based on current metrics.

deliverables.title: Final Grant Report with Impact Metrics & Base Ecosystem Contribution
deliverables.description: Produce comprehensive final report documenting all deliverables, on-chain metrics, user testimonials, and quantified contribution to Base ecosystem growth. deliverables.verificationEvidence: Published final report PDF (15-25 pages) with executive summary, detailed milestone completion evidence, and impact metrics; Video presentation (5-10 minutes) demonstrating live product and showcasing key achievements; Press release or ecosystem impact blog post published on Base Mirror publication or official channels; GitHub repository releases page with v1.0 tagged release including all documented deliverables; Grant committee acknowledgment email or public recognition.

deliverables.title: Base-to-Stellar Cross-Chain Bridge Mainnet Deployment

deliverables.title: User Onboarding Campaign: 2,500+ Wallet Activations

tranches.phaseObjective: Launch production-ready automated SAP/ERP integration connectors with AI-driven data mapping and scale enterprise client base from 8 to 25+ through targeted B2B sales execution.

deliverables.title: Launch automated SAP S/4HANA and Oracle ERP Cloud connectors
deliverables.description: Develop and release bi-directional API connectors for SAP S/4HANA and Oracle ERP Cloud that automatically sync purchase orders, invoices, and vendor master data with <5 minute latency. Include AI-powered field mapping that adapts to custom ERP configurations without manual coding.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Connector technical specification documents with API endpoint mappings, live demo video showing end-to-end data sync between ProcureSphere and both ERP systems, Git release tags for v1.0 of each connector, and at least 2 client proof-of-concept deployments with sync logs demonstrating successful bi-directional data flow.

deliverables.title: Deploy cloud-native auto-scaling infrastructure on GCP
deliverables.description: Migrate core SaaS platform to Google Cloud Platform (aligns with Google for Startups) using Kubernetes for container orchestration, implement auto-scaling policies to handle 10x transaction volume spikes, and establish <200ms p95 API response times under peak load.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: GCP project console screenshots showing resource utilization, Kubernetes cluster configuration files (YAML manifests), load testing report (using tools like JMeter or Locust) demonstrating successful handling of 100,000+ concurrent API requests, and application performance monitoring dashboard (e.g., Google Cloud Monitoring) displaying p95 latency metrics.

deliverables.title: Acquire 17 new enterprise clients (total 25 paying enterprises)
deliverables.description: Execute targeted outbound sales campaign to Fortune 5000 procurement teams, close minimum 17 new paid annual contracts (min $15k ACV each), and onboard clients to production with active transaction processing. Focus on industries with complex vendor ecosystems (manufacturing, healthcare, retail).
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Signed Master Services Agreements (MSAs) or Order Forms from 17 new enterprise clients with executed payment terms, CRM export (Salesforce/HubSpot) showing deal progression and closed-won dates, bank statements or revenue dashboard showing contract value totaling minimum $255k ARR from new clients, and client onboarding completion checklists with go-live dates.

deliverables.title: Implement predictive purchase recommendation engine using collaborative filtering
deliverables.description: Build ML-based recommendation system that analyzes cross-client purchasing patterns (anonymized and aggregated) to suggest optimal vendors, contract terms, and bulk purchasing opportunities. System must generate actionable recommendations for at least 20 enterprise clients.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Algorithm design document explaining collaborative filtering approach and data privacy safeguards, A/B test results showing recommendation acceptance rate >15% among pilot users, in-app screenshot of recommendation UI displaying suggested vendors with confidence scores, and data processing pipeline diagram showing anonymization and aggregation methods compliant with enterprise data policies.

tranches.name: Tranche 3: SOC2 Certification & Scale to 50 Enterprises
tranches.phaseObjective: Achieve SOC2 Type I certification to unlock enterprise sales at scale and reach 50 paying enterprise clients, validating product-market fit and satisfying grant's traction growth objectives.

deliverables.title: Obtain SOC2 Type I certification
deliverables.description: Complete SOC2 Type I audit examining design and implementation of security controls at a point in time. Remediate all critical and high-priority findings from Tranche 1 gap analysis, pass auditor testing, and receive official SOC2 Type I report.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Official SOC2 Type I audit report issued by accredited CPA firm with unqualified opinion (no material weaknesses), certificate of compliance with issue date within the tranche period, and customer-facing security portal or trust center webpage displaying SOC2 badge and report availability for prospects.

deliverables.title: Scale to 50 total paying enterprise clients
deliverables.description: Close and onboard 25 additional enterprise clients (from 25 to 50 total) leveraging SOC2 certification as sales enablement asset. Maintain average contract value of $18k+ ACV and achieve 100% onboarding completion with active monthly transaction processing exceeding $500k aggregate vendor volume.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Financial dashboard or accounting system export showing 50 active paying enterprise clients with recurring revenue line items, signed contracts or Order Forms for the 25 new clients acquired in this tranche, CRM pipeline report showing closed-won deals with dates, and platform usage analytics demonstrating >$500k in monthly vendor transaction volume processed across the 50-client base.

deliverables.title: Launch AI-driven contract negotiation assistant with NLP
deliverables.description: Release natural language processing feature that extracts key terms from vendor contracts (payment terms, SLAs, termination clauses), benchmarks against industry standards, and generates negotiation talking points. Train model on minimum 1,000 procurement contracts and achieve >80% accuracy on term extraction.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: NLP model training report with accuracy/precision metrics on validation dataset, product release notes for contract assistant feature, user guide or help documentation explaining functionality, live demonstration video showing contract upload and automated term extraction with negotiation recommendations, and feedback from at least 5 enterprise users confirming feature usage in real negotiations.

deliverables.title: Publish technical case study demonstrating proprietary AI/ML differentiation
deliverables.description: Author and publish detailed technical case study (blog post, white paper, or conference submission) showcasing ProcureSphere's proprietary AI/ML architecture, including spend anomaly detection, vendor risk scoring, and predictive recommendations. Include quantified business impact metrics from enterprise clients (cost savings %, time reduction, risk mitigation examples).
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Published case study URL (company blog, Medium, or industry publication), document includes architecture diagrams of ML pipelines and cloud infrastructure, anonymized client results showing measurable ROI (e.g., '15% cost savings, 40% faster invoice processing'), and social proof via client testimonial quotes or logos (with permission), plus minimum 500 views/downloads or presentation acceptance at recognized tech conference (e.g., Google Cloud Next, AWS re:Invent).

deliverables.title: SOC2 Type I Readiness Assessment & Gap Analysis Report
deliverables.description: Engage a qualified third-party auditor to conduct SOC2 Type I readiness assessment. Document current security posture, identify gaps in access controls, data encryption, logging, and incident response, and produce prioritized remediation roadmap.

deliverables.title: MoM User Growth Baseline Report (Current 8 Clients)
deliverables.description: Establish auditable growth tracking by documenting current 8 paying enterprise clients with contract values, user seats, monthly transaction volumes, and MRR. Create dashboard to track weekly active users, transaction throughput, and contract renewals.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: Anonymized client roster Excel/CSV showing contract start dates, MRR per client, and user seat counts; screenshot of live analytics dashboard (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or custom) displaying MAU, WAU, transaction volume metrics; signed contracts or invoices (redacted) proving recurring revenue from 8 enterprises.

deliverables.title: Pan-African Expansion Market Prioritization Study
deliverables.description: Conduct market research across Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, and Côte d'Ivoire to prioritize 2 target countries for expansion. Assess enterprise density, ERP adoption rates, payment infrastructure, regulatory environment, and competitive landscape. Produce ranked matrix with go-to-market feasibility scores.
deliverables.verificationEvidence: 20-page market research report with data sources cited (e.g., Statista, World Bank, local chambers of commerce); prioritization matrix scoring 5 countries across 6+ criteria; interviews summary with 3 local procurement/finance professionals or venture partners per target country (15 total); recommended 2-country expansion plan with rationale.

tranches.name: Tranche 2: SOC2 Certification & Client Acquisition Engine
tranches.phaseObjective: Achieve SOC2 Type I certification to unlock enterprise sales, activate scalable client acquisition channels in priority African markets, and demonstrate MoM user growth with 15+ new enterprise clients—directly fulfilling grant criteria for recurring revenue growth and pan-African expansion capability.

deliverables.title: SOC2 Type I Certification Achieved

deliverables.title: Onboard 15 Net-New Enterprise Clients (Total 23 Clients)

deliverables.verificationEvidence: Updated client roster CSV showing 23 total clients (8 baseline + 15 new) with contract dates, MRR, industry vertical, and country; 15 signed Master Service Agreements or Order Forms (redacted/anonymized); invoice or payment receipts proving initial subscription payments; CRM export (HubSpot, Salesforce) showing closed-won deals with dates.

deliverables.verificationEvidence: Signed MoU or partnership agreement on partner letterhead; joint press release or LinkedIn announcement post; partnership deck or co-marketing plan PDF outlining referral terms, lead-sharing process, and co-branded webinar or event scheduled.

tranches.name: Tranche 3: Scale to 50 Clients & Advanced Software IP
tranches.phaseObjective: Exceed funding target by scaling to 50+ enterprise clients, enhance software IP with AI-powered spend analytics, and showcase founding team's technical execution capability—cementing ProcureSphere as a scalable, tech-first pan-African procurement SaaS.

deliverables.title: Reach 50+ Enterprise Clients Under Contract
deliverables.description: Accelerate client acquisition through partner referrals, targeted digital campaigns, and in-market sales teams. Onboard 27 additional enterprise clients (23 from Tranche 2 + 27 = 50 total) with executed recurring revenue contracts and active platform usage.

deliverables.title: AI-Powered Spend Analytics Module (Proprietary Software IP)
